summary: Completed Phase 3 testing for Content Rating, Progress History, and Data Export features. All backend APIs working correctly (93.9% overall backend success rate). All frontend flows tested successfully including rating dialog, progress history timeline, and JSON export download.

backend_issues.notes: 4 test failures are from existing 1-3-5 rule enforcement tests (expected 400 status codes), not related to Phase 3 features

Backend: PUT /api/content/{id} accepts and persists rating field (1-5 stars) with status COMPLETED
Backend: GET /api/progress-logs?content_id={id} filters logs correctly and returns newest first
Frontend: Add content item to Growth Hub (book with 300 pages)
Frontend: Quick Log progress with Active Recall notes (2 entries: 50 pages + 75 pages)
Frontend: View Progress History sheet shows timeline with increments and notes
Frontend: Mark completed opens Rating dialog with 5-star picker
Frontend: Select 4 stars and save rating persists to backend
Frontend: Rating displayed on tracker card after save
Frontend: Settings Export JSON button triggers download with correct filename (lifeos-backup-YYYY-MM-DD.json)
Frontend: Toast notifications working for all actions
